criteria.title: Security store loads findings via ContextVM
criteria.description: The security store calls requestEncryptedResult with operation 'security/findings-list' and populates reactive state with the response payload.

criteria.title: Security store loads schedules via ContextVM
criteria.description: The security store calls requestEncryptedResult with operation 'security/schedules-list' and populates reactive state.

criteria.title: Security store triggers scan via ContextVM
criteria.description: The security store calls requestEncryptedResult with operation 'security/scan' and returns the accepted response with run_id.

criteria.title: Security store triggers rescan via ContextVM
criteria.description: The security store calls requestEncryptedResult with operation 'security/rescan' and returns the accepted response.

criteria.title: Dashboard route renders severity summary
criteria.description: The /security page shows aggregate severity counts (critical, high, moderate, low) derived from the loaded findings.

criteria.title: Dashboard route renders findings table
criteria.description: The /security page shows a table of findings with columns: OSV ID, CVE, package, severity, summary.

criteria.title: Dashboard route renders empty state
criteria.description: When no findings exist, the /security page shows an EmptyState component with appropriate messaging.

criteria.title: Detail route renders scan run findings
criteria.description: The /security/[id] page loads findings for a specific scan run and displays full details including references and aliases.

criteria.title: Nav link appears under Operations
criteria.description: The Security nav link appears in the Operations section of the navigation sidebar with the correct icon and href.

criteria.title: Loading and error states are handled
criteria.description: The security store and routes handle loading and error states without silent fallbacks.
